question: How many 4H main-trendline (V1.2) closing breaks on OKX USDT perpetuals were followed by a large run, and is that more frequent than matched random 4H bars?
kind: descriptive excursion census (no P&L backtest, no exit rule, no parameter search)
registered_before_results: 2026-11-09, written before any event was computed

data.source: OKX public history-candles bar=4H, confirmed candles only
data.universe: every live USDT-settled SWAP on 2026-11-09 (delisted contracts absent; survivorship not removed)

signal.indicator: yoyo/evaluation/pine/auto_trendline_4h_v1_2.pine (owner defaults: swing 3, minSpan 72, gap 24, nearAtr 0.65), resistance side only
signal.event: 收盘上破 = second consecutive 4H close above line + 0.15 ATR14
signal.pivot_ties: strict on both sides; bars that only qualify with ties are counted, not used
signal.entry: close of the break bar (known at that close)

stops.atr1: entry - 1 x ATR14 at the break bar

excursion: max high strictly before the first bar whose low <= stop; the stop bar's own high is excluded (stop assumed first). Peak gain % and peak R = (peak - entry) / (entry - stop).

control.pool: same symbol, bars within +-180 4H bars of the event, full horizon available, excluding the event bar

complete_horizon_only_for_comparison: events with < 180 forward bars are listed separately (includes the owner's PIEVERSE example) and excluded from event-vs-control rates
costs: taker 5bp per side reported as R cost per event; excursions are gross and descriptive, not realised returns
